rules.fixHint: InvokeAgentScope is present but no InferenceScope or ExecuteToolScope was found in the same trace. Both are required for store publishing — see instrument-observability Phase 5.5.
S2S agents must populate CallerDetails on InvokeAgentScope.Start(); without it, traces reach the API (200) but stay invisible in the MAC portal.
S2S agent posted to /observability/ instead of /observabilityService/ — set Agent365.Exporter.UseS2SEndpoint=true (.NET) or AGENT365_USE_S2S_ENDPOINT=true (Node.js).
service.name resource attribute is missing — set SERVICE_NAME (Node.js/Python) or use_microsoft_opentelemetry(service_name=...).
Span has parentSpanId but no matching parent in the same trace's captures — likely the parent emit was lost or the agent broke the parent context.
gen_ai.conversation.id differs across spans within one trace — baggage propagation likely broken; check BaggageBuilder usage in the message handler.
Required baggage keys missing on a non-root span — baggage was set on the InvokeAgent but not propagated to children. Confirm BaggageBuilder.run() wraps the entire handler body.
URL contains /otlp/ — Node.js / .NET SDK bug. Status: pending SDK fix; no client-side workaround is correct.
FMI token audience does not match the Observability API scope — token may be rejected by the gateway.
Child scope start time precedes its parent InvokeAgent start — likely a clock skew or the scope was opened outside the parent's using-block.
